what: the problems lens landed with a focus that could not run (a reserved word unquoted); the job printed the error and carried on, its failure hidden by a pipe
countermeasure: ocoeco check brings every lens into focus over the place, so a lens that cannot is not landed; jobs run with pipefail, so a piped command's failure stops them

what: the 45 conditions milestones rest on are written feature:voice-calls@linux-best, while the table is called features: one name for one place written two ways, as connection and connections. So the graph passes over all of them, and says that nothing points at any of the 46 features while 45 conditions do. Not mended by guessing that an s is missing: a name is not the place it names, and what is lacking is that the language say which names are one
the work lens's focus was recorded as landed while main held only the record: bringing every star to main for a proof wiped the code
countermeasure: after landing, main itself is read back; practice 25 (evidence before the word)

what: a place made by ocoeco init had no table for glimpses, decisions or problems: the first record of work there was refused (found in the author's observatory and in OCO's place, on their first day)
countermeasure: init gives a place all three from its first day, with the lenses that catch them; the two places made before are given them

what: readiness was read as how ready a milestone is, for days, without looking up what it means: it is the milestone's rung on the path. A lens was built on the misreading - a rung drawn as a filled bar - and a problem raised against Rhizoid on it
countermeasure: what a milestone has reached is counted from what it rests on (decisions:2026-11-13-a-milestone-is-read-off-what-it-rests-on); the rung is shown as a rung; the problem raised against Rhizoid is withdrawn there, in words

what: a row written into a table a place's own lens defines is checked against nothing: only the lenses built into ocoeco are the declaration a row is held to, so the lens of questions made through entries would have taken any word for any field

a run stopped because a newer one was asked for is shown as failing on main: seen when several landings within minutes each started an observation - the two observatories' runs read as cancelled, and the ones after them were running or had passed

tad's packing script with only the name changed was untrue for a package at the root - the rpm tool takes -p as a folder; and only the build was run before landing, not the packing: the first release carried no files
all links hold was written before the check ran, and a count was taken from copies on unlanded branches
countermeasure: a job writes its finding from what it counted, with every star on its main; practice 25

what: ocoeco glimpse wrote milestone: for the table milestones: seven links led nowhere, unseen since the day it was built
countermeasure: the writer fixed, the links mended, and ocoeco check now follows every link (decisions:2026-11-12-relations-declared)

what: a record named an item that is not there (backlog:the-switch in lab-agent) and was landed: a link was checked only when the place was, not when it was written
countermeasure: every write of rows - glimpse in both forms, and note - is guarded: if it adds a link that points nowhere, the place's tables are put back as they were and the link is named

what: what each milestone rests on is asked in the same words by both of purpose's parts - the list of what is being reached, and the count of what is reached. It was asked twice before as well, in words different enough that the lens of language could not see it; written the same way, it is seen. What is lacking: a part cannot name a shape that other parts - or other lenses - then ask of; a projection does not yet feed a lens as data

repeats is walked as a line, and its walk comes back to where it began: argenv-open-lists repeats ocoeco-on-argenv, which repeats argenv-open-lists. A repeat says two things are one need with different faces; that is not a direction but a group - the lens of the graph asks it as a line of one kind, as it asks led to and refines

what has run is observed twice: by the lab every quarter hour, and by the author's observatory on GitHub - two observers of one thing; both now say it the same way, through the lens of signs, so one failing run may be said twice
observed runs grew with each observation (45, then 135): the observatory exports what it observed, and the next observation gathered it back in and added to it
countermeasure: runs are observed, never gathered: each observation replaces the table whole; a test feeds earlier runs back in and sees them dropped

what: ocoeco's repository is the source of the program and a place that brings the same lenses: when a lens changes its name, the program installed and the place disagree until the new program is installed - met when the lens of signs was landed, and the order of the job changed for it

what a run's ending means is decided in two places - the lens of signs' query, and ocoeco's own code that says aloud what fails now - and within an hour they disagreed: the lens was corrected, and the lab went on telling the author urgently that two runs failed which had only been replaced by newer ones. A third thing does nearly the same: the voice that says what newly came into view through a lens

what fits offers, for a link, the rows of the place stood in: a link into another star - a decision in OCO's place written from ocoeco - is still typed from memory, and twice in one hour such a link was refused by the guard

what points nowhere is now said in two places - the check, in the program's own code, and the graph's part of the same name; the first time both were asked they agreed, 0 and 0, over every place. One meaning kept in two places
